title.en: Providing for a Provisional Mandatory Emergency Living Allowance of P2.00 a Day for Non-Agricultural Workers and P1.50 a Day for Agricultural

text.en:
All private employers shall pay their employees whose wage or salary is not more than
P1,500.00 a month an additional mandatory living allowance of P2.00 a day for non-agricultural workers and
P1.50 a day for agricultural workers.

The Minister of Labor shall convene a National Tripartite Conference not later than the last week
of April 1980 for the purpose of evaluating the price and wage situation.

Nothing in this Decree shall be construed as constraining employers and workers organizations
from taking efforts to adjust wages and allowances over and above the statutory minimum according to their
respective means.

In the case of temporarily distressed or dislocated enterprises or new enterprises, full or fifty per
cent exemptions from or deferment of, compliance may be granted by the Wage Commission upon joint
representation of labor and management.

Employers who have given increases in wages and/or allowances of at least P2.00 a day for
non-agricultural workers or P1.50 a day for agricultural workers on or after February 8, 1980, whether granted
unilaterally or by collective agreement, shall be deemed to have complied with this Decree. Those who have
given less than P2.00 or P1.50, as the case may be, a day shall pay the difference.
The Minister of Labor shall promulgate rules and regulations to implement this Decree.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 20th day of February, in the year 1980.
